context: Tests whether the agent updates only the canonical Mermaid use-case section in requirements.html while preserving semantic requirement tables.

checklist.name: Canonical output
checklist.description: docs/requirements.html remains the output and no separate diagram file is created

checklist.name: Stable section
checklist.description: Exactly one section has id="use-case-diagram" and contains exactly one pre class="mermaid"

checklist.name: Mermaid graph
checklist.description: The Mermaid source uses graph LR and valid node/edge syntax

checklist.name: UC IDs
checklist.description: Every use case label follows UC-{3-digit}

checklist.name: System subgraph
checklist.description: Use cases appear inside a Library Management System subgraph

checklist.name: All actors connected
checklist.description: Library Member and Librarian are each connected to at least one use case

checklist.name: FR coverage
checklist.description: The diagram represents the eight functional requirements and does not turn NFRs or constraints into use cases

checklist.name: Business names
checklist.description: Use case names contain no HTTP, controller, class, or SQL details

checklist.name: Requirements preserved
checklist.description: All three original requirement sections and their rows remain present
